events.body:
## Context

`public/chat.html` (about L129-131) `#messageInput` has only a placeholder, which doesn't count as a label.

## What to do

1. Add a visually hidden `<label for="messageInput">` or an `aria-label`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Lighthouse/axe report no unlabelled form element on /chat

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-byte && npx wrangler dev   # Lighthouse on /chat
```

---
